description: NaCa₂Si₃O₈(OH) is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one H and six O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.34 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.57 Å. There are two inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with four CaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.46 Å. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with four CaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.46 Å. There are three inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-59°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.69 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-66°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.68 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four CaO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-66°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.66 Å. H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.07 Å) and one longer (1.44 Å) H-O bond length. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Ca and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OCa₃Si tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Ca and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing OCa₃Si tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Si, and one H atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Ca and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Si, and one H atom.
